scope: 18 in-memory pilot-only calibration runs; no held-out cases
calibrationStatus: Pilot tuning only; unknown conditions still block aircraft validation
selectionNotes: Takeoff selected for unchanged pitch gates, not nearest runway distance.
Landing selected for improved sink/path tracking and lower pitch-rate limit than the rate-4 alternative.
The 0.16 g landing deceleration demand is a provisional ground-roll fit, not a verified Cirrus pilot instruction or tire-friction coefficient.
Airborne-distance comparisons are derived independently from total minus ground roll to expose compensating errors.
The baseline was reproduced on the same Node version, WASM artifact, XML hashes and loading as all candidates.

pitchTracking.basis: Project numerical tracking gates, not AFM tolerances; first-airborne and screen samples are not interpolated flight-test measurements
blockers: Takeoff pitch did not meet the project tracking gate at first sampled airborne state.
